month_theme: Final prep — 26 days until Phase 1 begins

must_do.text: Say 'update my plan' — career plan rebuild is ready. Phase 1 locked (Aug 1–mid-Dec), trips mapped, Duke confirmed Fall 2027. No more blockers. This is the week.
Finalize Coiba trip logistics — happening in July before Aug 1. Lock in exact dates, operator, transport. Not a gap year deliverable — just a trip, get it sorted now.
Open brokerage account — Fidelity or Schwab. 5+ weeks overdue. Gap year starts in 26 days. Financial habits should precede the routine, not follow it.

should_do.text: Begin C++ self-study — learncpp.com, VSCode + GCC, 30 min/day. The Aug 1 routine is 26 days away. Starting now means arriving there with 3.5 weeks of momentum.
Draft engineering project sprint proposal — sprint is in November, but proposal should be done before Europe (Oct 1). Rough outline this week.
Continue internship research — kicked off July 5. Build on the momentum: identify 3 target companies for Sophomore summer 2029 and what they look for.

could_do.text: Decide PPL path — Phase 2 (Jan–Mar 2027) or Phase 3 (Apr–Aug 2027). Helps finalize the career plan and internship timeline.
Open Fusion360 for 30 minutes — rebuild the muscle memory for the glider project. Just the interface, no pressure to design yet.

Coiba trip — must be booked and confirmed this week
Gap year Phase 1 begins — continuous routine in Panama City

notes: Gap year Phase 1 is fully mapped: Aug 1–mid-Dec, continuous routine in Panama City. Trips built in: Colorado (Sept), Europe Oct 1-15, engineering sprint (Nov), Japan (mid-Dec). The uncertainty you felt on July 4 is completely normal before a big transition — it's not a signal to rethink, it's a signal to start. The routine is the antidote to uncertainty. 26 days.
